Reporting the weighting scheme in a meta-analysis is relevant for the quality of the scientific report. This ensures accurate estimations of the effect size, taking into account the variability and sample size of the studies. It facilitates transparency and reproducibility, allowing other researchers to understand and replicate the analysis. Additionally, it helps to manage heterogeneity among studies and is vital for correctly interpreting the results. Detailed disclosure of the weighting scheme in the manuscript and supplementary material allows for critical evaluation and contributes to methodological improvement in the field, strengthening the credibility and robustness of the study.
